role: independent economy, probability and monetization critic
method: Mapped no-ad F2P, rewarded-ad F2P, monthly and high-spend boundaries across MASTER_SPEC, user-decision locks, policy gates and Step 2 dependency closure.

Attempted rejection for ruby/evolution budget collision, character/weapon pool mixing, hidden rarity lock, unbounded paid multiplier, forced-ad dependency, fake-value catalog and exact competitor-value copying.

findings.finding: The exact ruby consumption order and catalog values are intentionally deferred to the Step 2 candidate rather than fixed in Step 1.
findings.whyNotBlockingStep1: The dependency closure requires an explicit order, provenance conservation, exact schema and fixtures; Step 2 can select and seal one candidate without changing product meaning.
findings.blockingCondition: Blocks Step 2 executable seal if the candidate omits order, provenance, deficits, disclosures or conservation fixtures.
